properties.name: autto.execution.capabilities
properties.description: W3C / vendor capabilities. Names with ':' work as-is, e.g. se:recordVideo: true or bstack:options: {os: Windows}.

properties.name: autto.browser.prefs
properties.description: Browser preferences (Chromium 'prefs' / Firefox profile), e.g. intl.accept_languages: es-ES.

properties.name: autto.report.info
properties.description: Extra rows of the report dashboard environment table.

properties.name: autto.api.headers
properties.description: Default HTTP headers of every API request, e.g. Authorization: Bearer ${API_TOKEN}. Values of sensitive headers are masked in the report.

properties.name: autto.dotenv.path
properties.description: Explicit location of the .env file (also AUTTO_DOTENV_PATH). By default it is searched in the working directory and up to three parent folders.
